service_boundary: Represents customer-created Inference Endpoints, not Inference Providers routing, the Hub repository alone, Spaces, or self-hosted inference engines.
regional_controls: Customers choose among documented AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud regions and instance types; private connectivity support is provider- and region-specific.
retention_controls: Hugging Face states it does not store endpoint request payloads or tokens and retains service logs for 30 days. Uploaded model repositories and deployment resources remain stored customer assets.
routing: Traffic targets a customer-created endpoint and its autoscaling replicas rather than an external provider-selection layer.
customization: Customers choose model repositories, revisions, inference engines, containers, hardware, scaling, and custom handlers.
strengths: Dedicated model deployments combine Hub artifacts with managed infrastructure and autoscaling.
Cloud, region, hardware, access, and private-network choices are explicit.
tradeoffs: Customers retain more deployment and model-compatibility responsibility than serverless catalogs.
Available regions and private connectivity differ by underlying cloud.
